propositions: Budget-enforcement globals LEDGER_CAP_USD and LEDGER_RESERVE_USD are hardcoded to one epic's ceiling, preventing sibling epics from having separate enforceable budgets.
Two epics sharing a single ledger file would each observe only their own spend but face a shared cap, causing incorrect refusal logic and budget violations.
The estimate tier dictionary lacks parent epic's evaluation keys, preventing pre-flight pricing for criteria-eval work.
reserve() and print_summary() must accept keyword-only cap_usd and reserve_usd parameters with defaults matching current globals to enable per-epic budget ceilings without breaking existing callers.
estimate() must support two new tier keys 'criteria-eval-cheap' and 'criteria-eval-agent' with rates derived from production ledger data.
